name: Cizzle Biotechnology Holdings Plc
summary: Cizzle Biotechnology Holdings Plc specializes in developing an advanced immunoassay diagnostic test. This innovative tool aims to identify the CIZ1B biomarker, facilitating the early detection of lung cancer. The company, previously known as Cizzle Biotechnology Limited, officially changed its corporate identity to Cizzle Biotechnology Holdings Plc in May 2021. Its main operational base is situated in London, United Kingdom.
